content: MDN Popover API: popovers are ALWAYS non-modal (modal requires dialog+showModal). popover=manual cannot be light-dismissed: no Esc, no outside-click close; must be closed explicitly via hidePopover()/popovertarget - so D18-01 manual Esc handling is mandatory with manual state. Closed popover = display:none (removed from a11y tree and tab order automatically). Open popover is in the top layer above all content, unaffected by ancestor overflow/position. Baseline 2024/2025 across Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. :popover-open pseudo-class styles open state.
